reason: Entries: only JSR sky_row from sky_draw (sky_main), sky_zero (sky_main) and sky_check (sky.6502); no sky_row+N, no fall-in (RTS before, SKIP 4 after it before .sky_draw keeps later addresses). sky_rn is 1..8 on every entry: bottom row sky_L+1 (L = A AND 7), middle rows 8, top what is left of sky_H-(L+1) after subtracting 8s with sky_H from sky_heights 23..28 (zero entries go to fall) or sky_h,X saved from it, so the remainder is >= 15 before the loop and 1..8 at top; split entries copy those. For n in 1..8, (n-1) EOR 7 = 8-n. Exit: A = 8-n, N/Z from it (old LDA sky_skip, new EOR #7; STA keeps flags), X unchanged, Y = sky_rt,X OR sky_ry,X (computed earlier, inputs not written by the moved stores), s_ptr+1, sky_n, sky_skip same values. C: old 1, new entry C; V: old 0 (ADC of -(n+1)+9 never overflows), new entry V. No caller reads them: sky_draw part ASLs (C from bit 7 of A<=7, then ADC), whole path to next_row CPX; sky_zero/sky_check cell paths SEC before SBC, whole paths reach CPX/CLC/SEC without branching on C or V; every BVC/BVS in sky*/render follows its own BIT. Stack unchanged. IRQ: registers preserved, same zero-page bytes written, only the order of sky_skip vs the TAY changes; irq1_handler does not read &C3/&DE/&DF mid-routine any differently. Cycles: old EOR#2+SEC2+ADC#2+LDA zp3 = 9, new DEC A 2 + EOR# 2 = 4: 5 saved; bytes 7 -> 3, 4 saved, retaken by SKIP 4 (net 0).
